config.script:
if self.view.params.label == "Priority Assignment":
		system.perspective.navigate(url="http://localhost:8088/data/perspective/client/Hitachi_Energy_Transformer/sup_job_board")
		
	elif self.view.params.label == "Supervisor Assistance":
		#system.perspective.navigate(url="http://localhost:8088/data/perspective/client/Hitachi_Energy_Transformer/sup_assist_req")
		params = {	"action": "confirm",
				"primaryText": "Please confirm you want supervisor assistance!",
				"secondaryText":" Supervisor will be notified about the assistance requirment","label":self.view.params.label}
		system.perspective.openPopup("PopUp", view = "Project/Pop-Up/Pop-up", 
										params = params, 
										showCloseIcon = False,
										draggable = False, 
										modal = True)
	elif self.view.params.label == "Log Downtime":
		system.perspective.navigate(url="http://localhost:8088/data/perspective/client/Hitachi_Energy_Transformer/opr_downtime_entry")
	elif self.view.params.label ==  "Downtime Monitor":
		system.perspective.navigate(url="http://localhost:8088/data/perspective/client/Hitachi_Energy_Transformer/sup_downtime_monitor")
	elif self.view.params.label ==  "Break":
		params = {	"action": "confirm",
				"primaryText": "Please confirm you want to go for a Break !",
				"secondaryText":" You will be logged out from the current session once you press confirm.",
				"label":self.view.params.label}
		system.perspective.openPopup("PopUp", view = "Project/Pop-Up/Pop-up", 
										params = params, 
										showCloseIcon = False,
										draggable = False, 
										modal = True)
	elif self.view.params.label ==  "Lunch Break":
		params = {	"action": "confirm",
				"primaryText": "Please confirm you want to go for Lunch Break !",
				"secondaryText":" You will be logged out from the current session once you press confirm.",
				"label":self.view.params.label}
		system.perspective.openPopup("PopUp", view = "Project/Pop-Up/Pop-up", 
										params = params, 
										showCloseIcon = False,
										draggable = False, 
										modal = True)
